references.text: The Lord had previously spoken to Moses about Aaron's role as a spokesman, which explains why the Lord now speaks to both of them.
The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them the command to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.
Moses and Aaron are mentioned together as those entrusted with leading the Israelites out of Egypt.
The context of the Lord's speech to Moses and Aaron, where Aaron is to serve as Moses' prophet before Pharaoh.
Another important occasion when the Lord spoke to both Moses and Aaron together.
The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, showing that this was a pattern in God's communication with them.
